correctness.rationale: All three arrow sets and total composition table are explicitly defined with no possible length-three associativity constraint. The Γ graph consists of s relator cycles joined at one base arrow plus degree-one leaves; its edge labels project each cyclic generator to the corresponding precise signed attaching word in a rank-k rose. The cited sink mapping-cone lemma recovers the presentation two-complex. The one- and two-object lower bound follows from nerve dimension and the graph realizations are explicit. Eight finite checker samples are corroboration, not substituted for the general proof.
